reason: Wrap-up steps (plan tick, progress log, commit, push) recur across Farfield sessions, but no skill holds them. In this episode the assistant committed and pushed a progress entry during a pure question turn, which the project rules forbid.
"enchaine" was read as approval of the work, while the pack log still predated the jar, so the fog sliders were not tested in the pack. Only a verdict on the thing itself should tick an item.
A session that crossed midnight produced a second dated progress file; the rule for where post-midnight work is logged was improvised and should be written down.

The wrap-up committed and pushed a progress log whose commit row read "(this commit)" instead of the hash (6ee5a82). The skill says to add the commit to its table but does not say how when the hash only exists after the commit, so the placeholder shipped.
